svg.desc: 2D front elevation of a truss bridge, to be extruded into 3D. CONVENTIONS - All dimensions in millimetres (mm). - Drawing plane = front elevation: horizontal = X, vertical in the picture = physical H (height). - SVG coordinate mapping: svg_x = X, svg_y = 1180 - H (i.e. physical height H, ground at H=0, picture top = H=1180). - Extrusion depth along Y (into the page) = 400 mm; each element is a box from H_lo to H_hi. ELEMENTS (X from..to, H from..to, thickness in Y) piars x 175..325 and x 1675..1825, H 0..400, depth 150 deck x 0..2000, H 400..500, depth 400 verticals x-centres 250, 625, 1000, 1375, 1750; width 80 (x), H 500..1100, depth 80 top_chord x 250..1750, H 1100..1180, depth 80 diagonals square bar section 60x60, centred on segments: (625, 500) -> (250, 1100) (625, 1100) -> (1000, 500) (1000, 500) -> (1375, 1100) (1375, 1100) -> (1750, 500) (diagonal endpoints are x-centres at the deck/top-chord levels) TOTAL: X span 0..2000, H 0..1180, Y 0..400
